title: Brazilian Chicken Skewers with Lush Salad
description: A flavorful and colorful Brazilian-inspired dish featuring marinated chicken skewers served with a fresh lush salad.

ingredients.name: Lush mixed greens
ingredients.notes: such as arugula, spinach, and lettuce

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lime juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add chicken pieces to the marinade and mix well.
Thread chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with marinade and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Meanwhile, combine lush mixed greens and dense pineapple in a large bowl.
Serve skewers hot with lush salad on the side.
Garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
